title: Disaster Recovery Planning — practice
prompt: You are working on “Disaster Recovery Planning” in a dedicated MongoDB practice environment. Which next step best demonstrates the skill while keeping the result reviewable?
objective: Apply disaster recovery planning and verify its result safely.

options: Disable access controls and embed connection credentials in source code to avoid configuration work.
Assume the reference output guarantees behavior across all MongoDB versions and deployment types.
Skip validation and run the broadest possible operation immediately in production.
Write a backup and recovery runbook with explicit scope, expected evidence, a restore check, and a rollback/notification step; rehearse only with test data.

expected_output: Write a backup and recovery runbook with explicit scope, expected evidence, a restore check, and a rollback/notification step; rehearse only with test data.

hints: Identify the data or operational behavior the task needs to demonstrate.
